page_title: Noty.ai - Meeting AI Assistant getting work done

sources.entry: Noty.ai - Converts meeting content into executable tasks. #free

summary.name: Noty.ai
summary.one_liner: Noty.ai is an AI meeting assistant that transcribes and summarizes meetings and turns discussed tasks, deadlines and assignees into to-do lists.
use_cases: Recording and transcribing meetings in real time
Extracting action items and deadlines from meetings
Sending assigned tasks to teammates by email
Tracking team task progress and deadlines
summary.what_it_does: Noty records and displays real-time transcriptions during meetings, and users can highlight key moments or add comments. After a meeting it generates a summary that can be reviewed, edited, commented on, and shared, and users can chat with it to find information. It detects tasks, deadlines and assignees discussed in the meeting and places them in a to-do list, which users can review, approve, and send to assignees by email. The page also says meeting summaries and action items can be sent to a connected workspace or preferred tools.
notable: Detects tasks, deadlines and assignees from meeting content and builds to-do lists
Approve and email tasks to assignees after the meeting
Chat with Noty to find information in meeting transcripts
caveats: Page does not state platform support beyond the website; supported languages, transcription accuracy, integration list, and storage/email limits are listed in the FAQ but not answered in the page text
Listing tags it as free, but the page text itself does not state pricing or free-tier limits
